headlines.title: 정부, 중동전쟁 물가 대응 총력 … 농축수산물 할인·비축물량 방출

headlines.title: 공급 확대에 채소값 안정세 … 대형마트서 매출 늘어
headlines.summary: 오이·배추·무 가격 두자릿수 하락 축·수산물 부담에 소비 증가 뚜렷 식탁에 채소 반찬이 늘고 있다. 축·수산물 가격 부담이 커진 반면, 채소류 가격이 상대적으로 안정세를 보이면서다. 14일 한국농수산식품유통공사(aT) 농산물유통정보(KAMIS)에 따르면 지난 12일 기준 오이 10개는 8742원으로 전년 동기(1만1569원) 대비 24.44% 하락했다.

headlines.title: 외국인이 ‘ 다주택자 급매 잡았나 ’… 서울 944채 매수

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

정부는 5월 그린북을 통해 1분기 성장세 확대 등 경기 회복 흐름을 인정하면서도, 미국의 관세 부과로 인한 수출 둔화 우려를 공식 언급하며 다섯 달 연속 "경기 하방압력 증가" 판단을 유지했다. OECD 역시 한국 등 수출 중심 경제의 성과가 가계 압박을 상쇄하지 못하고 있다고 지적하며, 대외 성장과 내수 체감 간의 괴리 문제를 부각시켰다. 대외적으로는 미국의 4월 수입물가가 에너지 급등에 힘입어 4년 만에 최고 수준인 1.9%까지 치솟으며 글로벌 인플레이션 재점화 가능성이 제기되고 있어, 한국의 수출 환경과 교역 조건에도 부담으로 작용할 전망이다. 채권시장에서는 금리 방향성을 둘러싼 강세·약세 세력 간의 팽팽한 대결 구도가 형성되며 불확실성이 고조되는 양상이다. 결국 오늘의 경제 흐름은 **회복의 신호와 하방 리스크가 공존하는 가운데, 대외 변수(관세·물가)가 한국 경제의 향방을 좌우하는 핵심 변수**로 부상하고 있음을 보여준다.

top5_headlines.summary: 종전 협상 교착…위험 회피 심리↑ 美 워시 등판불구 금리인하 기대↓ 외국인 코스피 5일간 24조 순매도 ‘이란 전쟁’ 종전 협상에 안정세를 찾는 듯했던 원/달러 환율이 다시 상승 국면에 진입하면서 1500원선을 위협하고 있다. 휴전 협상 장기화로 종전에 대한 기대감이 낮아진 데다, 고유가에 따른 미국의 금리 인하 가능성도 작아진 영향으로 풀이된다.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Q1 Tax Revenue Surges 15 Trillion Won Amid Semiconductor Recovery and Stock Market Gains
key_headlines.summary: Bolstered by semiconductor industry recovery and strong stock market performance, South Korea recorded its smallest fiscal deficit in six years during the first quarter. Tax revenue increased by over 15 trillion won year-over-year.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Threatens 1500 Level as Foreign Investors Sell Korean Stocks
key_headlines.summary: The Korean won weakened against the US dollar, approaching 1500 won per dollar, as foreign investors continued net selling of Korean stocks amid concerns about global inflation and potential interest rate hikes. The currency fluctuated significantly as external pressures mounted.

key_headlines.title: Japan's 10-Year Government Bond Yield Hits 29-Year High Amid Price Shock
key_headlines.summary: Japanese long-term bond yields surged to 2.7% or higher, reaching a 29-year record high as inflationary pressures spread globally. This marks a significant shift in Japan's monetary environment after decades of low interest rates.

key_headlines.title: Powell's Successor Washee Takes Over as Federal Reserve Chair Amid Pressure to Lower Interest Rates
key_headlines.summary: New Federal Reserve Chairman Washee received Senate confirmation and will preside over the June FOMC meeting, facing pressure from President Trump to cut interest rates while combating persistent inflation. The bond market anticipates continued monetary tightening despite political pressure.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Prices Rise 0.55% in April as Property Market Shows Recovery Signs
key_headlines.summary: Seoul housing prices accelerated their monthly increase to 0.55% in April, representing a three-month rebound, with rental prices also strengthening across Seoul and the surrounding Gyeonggi Province. Development prospects in certain districts drove renewed buyer interest.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economy shows mixed signals as the semiconductor sector and stock markets drive positive fiscal outcomes, yet underlying consumption and employment indicators remain weak. The first quarter recorded a 15 trillion won increase in tax revenue and the smallest fiscal deficit in six years, supported by semiconductor industry recovery and AI-driven stock market momentum. However, import prices have moderated for the first time in ten months while export prices hit a 28-year high, signaling potential headwinds ahead. Global inflationary pressures from energy and other sectors continue to pose downside risks to Korea's export-dependent economy.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Fitch forecasts that the Bank of Korea will maintain its benchmark interest rate throughout 2026, though it could raise rates in the second half if energy prices trigger inflation pressures. Import prices declined 2.3% month-over-month in April, the first decrease in ten months, largely due to falling global oil prices, while export prices reached a 28-year high. The government emphasized fiscal and monetary policy coordination as the newly reconstituted Ministry of Economy and Finance visited the Bank of Korea, signaling closer institutional cooperation. Despite strong Q1 tax revenues totaling over 15 trillion won more than last year, concerns persist that rising prices in the US could undermine Korea's semiconductor sector.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean won weakened significantly against the US dollar, approaching 1500 won per dollar as foreign investors engaged in sustained net selling of Korean stocks, reaching over 2 trillion won in daily outflows. Global bond yields surged as inflation concerns spread, with Japan's 10-year government bond yield hitting 2.7% for a 29-year high, while US 30-year Treasury yields breached 5%. Foreign investor outflows from Korean equities were driven by concerns about global inflation and the possibility of higher interest rates, offsetting earlier hopes for US-Iran peace negotiations. The yen and dollar strengthened against other currencies as the market priced in extended monetary tightening globally.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korean industrial equipment and battery manufacturers achieved strong Q1 results, with M-Plus recording 102 billion won in operating profit driven by overseas demand for rectangular battery assembly equipment and energy storage systems. RS Automation achieved double-digit revenue growth of 26.7%, benefiting from semiconductor industry recovery and expanding domestic automation investments alongside increased exports. Companies supplying to global AI data centers and advanced battery sectors demonstrated particular strength as clean energy transition accelerates worldwide. However, 94% of Korean automotive parts suppliers face a 'blind spot' regarding future vehicle technology, prompting the government to allocate 18 trillion won this year toward advanced industry ecosystem development.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices accelerated their monthly increase to 0.55% in April, a three-month rebound from previous weakness, with year-to-date appreciation reaching 2.7%. Rental prices strengthened across Seoul and Gyeonggi Province as demand remains steady, particularly in neighborhoods with good transit access and development prospects. Some regions experienced transaction declines and wait-and-see sentiment, but areas with redevelopment opportunities and reconstruction projects showed renewed buyer interest. The housing market demonstrated recovery signs despite broader economic headwinds, with investors increasingly interested in property ownership amid volatile stock market conditions.
sections.International Economy: New Federal Reserve Chairman Washee takes office amid unprecedented pressure from President Trump to lower interest rates while confronting persistent global inflation concerns that contradict rate-cut expectations. Washee will preside over the June FOMC meeting and has emphasized Federal Reserve independence, but faces a fractious committee where the April meeting recorded four dissenting votes, the most since 1992, signaling disagreement over policy direction. Global economic uncertainty intensifies as the US implements trade policies and engages in high-level negotiations with China, potentially reshaping international trade dynamics. The appointment of a new Fed chair amid these tensions underscores the central challenge of balancing political pressure against inflation control in the world's largest economy.
sections.AI & Economy: Gwangju's Advanced 3 District has emerged as a focal point for major corporate AI investments, with Samsung Electronics considering production line development and SK Group collaborating with OpenAI on potential data center locations. Gawon Electronics achieved record Q1 operating profit of 27.8 billion won, driven primarily by expanded bus duct supply to major US tech companies' growing AI data centers. South Korea's AI and semiconductor industry position strengthens as Nobel laureate economist Peter Howitt advised the government on sustaining innovation-driven growth, noting Korea's already leading status in advanced technology sectors. The government is mobilizing substantial resources for AI industry development, recognizing both the tremendous opportunities and the need for strategic coordination across the 12 advanced industries identified for national growth investment.
sections.Others: The Personal Information Protection Commission conducted field inspections at Hyundai Motor's research facility to address regulatory challenges surrounding physical AI and robotics technologies as they increasingly integrate into daily life. New regulatory frameworks are being developed to ensure personal data protection while enabling rapid innovation in autonomous robots and AI-powered video recognition systems. South Korea continues to strengthen institutional cooperation between economic agencies and international engagement with global economic leaders to position itself advantageously in the evolving global economic landscape. Trade policy coordination with the United States remains a critical focus as the Trump administration implements new trade measures that could significantly impact Korean export industries.
